Affiliate & sponsorship disclosure

How we make money, and what that never changes.

Affiliate links

Some "Official Link" and "Visit" buttons may be affiliate links. If you click one and buy, the vendor may pay us a commission. You pay the same price either way.

What it never changes

Commissions never affect our verdicts, rankings, pros and cons, or pricing notes. We list tools that have no affiliate program, and we don't remove or downgrade a tool because it doesn't pay us. Prices are taken from each vendor's own site; always confirm before you buy.

Sponsored placements

Featured Partner spots and newsletter sponsorships are paid. They are always labeled "Featured" or "Sponsored" and are kept separate from our reviews.

How to tell

Affiliate and sponsored links carry rel="sponsored". Questions? Email mainstreettools@gmail.com.
